reviewKind: Independent AI-assisted semantic comparison with retained official Microsoft source text
method: Read every prompt, key, option and explanation across the four packs. Compared technical claims with actual retrieved Microsoft Learn teaching/exercise text and retained current product documentation, including current limitations that supersede older training wording. Checked exactly one supported answer under each scenario, module relevance and valid teaching/exercise lesson IDs. Cache availability, URL matching and hashes were not used as substitutes for semantic review. No Azure resource operations, human approval or comparison against actual exam banks was performed. These are original revision questions; official knowledge-check questions were excluded from source comparison.
